crossRefs.note: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for…
Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the…
Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness…
While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he…
I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
“I, Yahweh, have called you in righteousness. I will hold your hand. I will keep you, and make you a covenant for the…
to open the blind eyes, to bring the prisoners out of the dungeon, and those who sit in darkness out of the prison.
Indeed, he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore…
“Arise, shine; for your light has come, and Yahweh’s glory has risen on you.
But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out, and leap…
the people who sat in darkness saw a great light, to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has…
a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”
For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation…
to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive…
how the Christ must suffer, and how, by the resurrection of the dead, he would be first to proclaim light both to these…
Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
